mentions.name: Formally verified 1D Ruckig implementation
mentions.description: This project is a formally verified, simplified one-dimensional implementation of Ruckig, a motion trajectory generation library. It is being built primarily to learn formal verification tools, and tackles numeric stability challenges using arbitrary-precision arithmetic. Correctness arguments currently treat a formalization of Sturm's theorem as an axiom, with no full bridge to it yet.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to write a formally verified simplified (1D) implementation of Ruckig, more to learn the tools than for the result, although I want that too.
